635:t_011:2.en:
$$トライア$$
(No...! The $$宇宙怪獣$$ didn't warp here on their own!)

635:t_011:3.en:
$$トライア$$
(Someone sent both the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$宇宙怪獣$$...!)

635:t_012:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's different from before! The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ clearly intend to attack now!」

635:t_012:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Did the $$宇宙怪獣$$' appearance trigger it!?」

635:t_012:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ have fought $$宇宙怪獣$$ before as well. I infer that they are mistaking us for them.」

635:t_012:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Unless we at least stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, things will get out of control!」

635:t_012:7.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「How can you say that at a time like this!?」

635:t_012:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll keep believing in $$刹那$$'s determination until the very last moment!」

635:t_012:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've known him since the $$破界事変$$! I guarantee he's a man who always comes through when it counts!」

635:t_012:11.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's right. Against both $$アレハンドロ$$ and $$リボンズ$$, he was the one who settled things in the end.」

635:t_012:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If the $$大グレン団$$'s fearsome leader goes that far, we have no choice but to wait too.」

635:t_012:13.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Come on, $$刹那$$! Hurry your ass up!」

635:t_012:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you're an $$イノベイター$$, please open the way to humanity's future!」

635:t_013:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't sweat it! The real fight starts now!」

635:t_013:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But you'll have to work to make up for being late!」

635:t_013:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The situation is quite grim. Tell us what you have in mind.」

635:t_013:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「That enormous $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ is like a nucleus. I'll make contact with it and share consciousness with all the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

635:t_013:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But then... the same thing as last time will...!」

635:t_014:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「The $$ラファエル$$...! Is that you, $$ティエリア$$!?」

635:t_014:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I was late because I came from the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

635:t_014:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Y-You... I thought you died!?」

635:t_014:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「As an $$イノベイド$$, my body is nothing more than a vessel.」

635:t_014:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But now I want to feel everything through a body, just like you.」

635:t_014:6.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Understood. Let's fight together, $$ティエリア$$.」

635:t_014:7.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Welcome back, $$アーデ$$! I love you!!」

635:t_014:9.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Oh my, isn't that nice? You've found yourself a wonderful boyfriend.」

635:t_014:11.en:
$$イアン$$
「This isn't something to laugh about, $$刹那$$!」

635:t_014:12.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'll monitor the $$クアンタ$$.」

635:t_014:17.en:
$$フェルト$$
「His love is too vast... I love him... And that's enough for me.」

635:t_014:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All right. I'm counting on you to monitor the $$クアンタ$$.」

635:t_015:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Unless we stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ attacks before beginning dialogue, we can't do anything.」

635:t_015:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Living means continuing to exist despite contradictions... It is exactly as you said.」

635:t_015:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「But I want to avoid unnecessary harm as much as possible.」

635:t_015:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The optimal attack point $$ヴェーダ$$ calculated is there.」

635:t_016:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「So we just punch that spot and stop them!」

635:t_016:2.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Fighting... isn't supposed to be our goal...!」

635:t_016:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't worry! Sometimes trading punches helps you understand each other!」

635:t_016:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah! If we're gonna have a dialogue anyway, we'll do it our way!」

635:t_016:7.en:
$n
「We won't fight out of hatred! If we put our will to protect what matters into it...!」

635:t_017:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll take on the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

635:t_018:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ダブルオークアンタ$$! I, $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$, will open the way!!」

635:t_019:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The giant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' activity is slowing!」

635:t_019:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One moment, please! The dimensional boundary is distorting again!」

635:t_020:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$!」

635:t_020:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「There are five cruiser-class monsters! Compared to that giant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...!」

635:t_020:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Wait, $$ノリコ$$! Those $$宇宙怪獣$$ aren't ordinary cruiser-class monsters!」

635:t_021:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Gravitational collapse has been detected within those $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

635:t_021:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Are you saying they evolved by swallowing black holes!?」
